artifacts.summary: Traces the exact call chain (command-gate-out.sh -> skill_validate_task_artifacts -> validate-artifact.sh --fix), confirms --fix's blast radius is limited to inserting TBD metadata placeholders, proposes propagating fix/error/warning counts via caller-visible global variables (matching skill-base.sh's existing convention) and a one-line always-on report in command-gate-out.sh, and decides --fix should remain in-place-mutating with reasoning.
